title: Explaining Economic Causes
goal: Explain economic causes precisely with formal connectors and core inflation vocabulary.
grammar: formal cause connectors (debido a, a raíz de, como consecuencia de, dado que)

items: I can distinguish noun-phrase cause connectors (*debido a*, *a raíz de*, *como consecuencia de*) from clause-taking *dado que*.
I can explain inflation and credit shifts using vocabulary such as *el banco central*, *las tasas de interés* and *el poder adquisitivo*.
I can link a triggering economic event to its market consequence in formal analysis.
